questions.question: Where does the rain go? Every gutter must drain into a downpipe fixed to a wall all the way down to the ground: no pipe in front of a loggia, across a window or in the air.
questions.why: rain running down a facade stains it and a pipe in the air looks like a mistake

questions.question: Does every tree and shrub stand on open ground, clear of the house, the pools, the paths and the terraces?
questions.why: a tree through a terrace or in front of a door is a reading or placement error
